properties.description:
`loop_status` carries `served_by` with an explicit `stale` bit, and when that bit is not `false` the remedy LEADS `next` — the list an agent acts on — naming `--stop-shared` and killing the assumption that a session restart is enough.

CHEAP WHEN CURRENT, LOUD WHEN NOT. The ~1 KB remedy note is dropped when the answer is `false`, so the ordinary call pays three fields; `cap:loop-status`'s "one cheap call" is not eroded the way the per-check roll eroded it once.

WHAT WAS ALREADY BUILT, so this is reachability and not detection: the bit itself has existed since 2026-08-08 under `req:the-server-is-the-authority-on-its-own-currency` — derived from `/proc/self/exe` rather than a version string, precisely because four sessions once read one true version and drew opposite conclusions. It rode on `graph_report` alone, which nothing points a session at.
properties.name: The orientation call says whether the server answering it is the code on disk
